raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error by misidentifying the primary tissue composition of the skin. While the skin is indeed the largest sensory organ and contains nerve tissue, it is primarily composed of epithelial tissue (specifically stratified squamous epithelium), not nerve tissue. The brain, conversely, consists mostly of nerve tissue (neurons and glial cells). The Planner failed to apply basic biological knowledge regarding tissue distribution, incorrectly prioritizing the "sensory" aspect of the skin over its structural composition, and prematurely concluded the task without verifying the specific tissue percentages of the options.
